text:
Erin Lopez: quick PR to harmonize the region availability copy and add a short note about data residency for Private installs. added ap-sg and eu-west-2 entries to the CSV. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/907

Tom Bianchi: thanks. can we make the residency blurb clearer about which artifacts are covered (request logs vs. model cache)? current sentence says "logs and data" which is vague.

Rajiv Menon: good catch. suggest: "Private deployments: customer-controlled compute and storage; request payloads and persistent logs remain within the VPC unless explicitly forwarded. Model cache (KV cache) may be stored on local disk and is not considered long-term customer data unless configured."

Erin Lopez: solid wording. also found a dangling link to the compliance page (the anchor changed). will fix.

Anika Shah: small ask: add micro-examples for the SDK region flag (node + go). prefer flag name `region` in SDK config, but show the header sample `X-Redwood-Region`.

Tom Bianchi: agree. we should include a one-line migration note for on-prem customers: "If you previously relied on global routing, pin the region config in your agent to avoid accidental cross-region routing during rollouts." Keep it short and prescriptive.

Erin Lopez: drafting snippets now.

```js
// node SDK config
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, region: 'ap-sg-1' });
```

```go
// go SDK config
cfg := redwood.DefaultConfig()
cfg.Region = "eu-west-2"
client := redwood.NewClient(cfg)
```

Rajiv Menon: pushed CSV row update and fixed the compliance anchor redirect. left a tiny nit about linking the migration note to the on-prem runbook.

docs-bot: deploy-preview for PR #907: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/907 60 review requested.

Anika Shah: preview looks good on desktop; mobile wraps the code box oddly — I adjusted the fences and added a short sentence above each snippet: "SDK configuration example" to help screen readers.

Tom Bianchi: LGTM. merging after CI. thanks everyone.

Erin Lopez: merging now. will add a brief internal note in the onboarding doc to remind infra teams to pin agent regions during migration windows.
